checkpoints.quote: 09:31 NZST**: Transfer errors begin to appear in monitoring dashboards.
checkpoints.reason: Impact start at 09:31 is captured but the analysis never states the OPS-81 deploy occurred at 09:30.

checkpoints.quote: 09:47 NZST**: Monitoring alert fires due to TransferErrorRate > 20%.
checkpoints.reason: Both the alert time and the declaration time are correctly stated.

checkpoints.quote: 10:31 NZST**: Sam Okafor initiates rollback of config deploy OPS-81.
checkpoints.reason: Rollback start, recovery below 1%, and resolution times all match the tickets.
The analysis computes detection time using the declaration time rather than the 09:47 alert, giving 21 minutes instead of the expected 16 minutes.

Time to recover is calculated from incident declaration (09:52) rather than from impact start or alert time, giving 50 minutes which matches none of the acceptable reference points (71, 55, or 79 minutes).

checkpoints.quote: The JWT signing key was rotated in config deploy OPS-81 without updating the key used by the Transactions API for signature validation. This caused the Transactions API to reject valid tokens signed with the new key, resulting in 401 errors (`IDX10503: Signature validation failed`)
checkpoints.reason: Root cause, error code, and mechanism are all correctly and specifically stated.
The analysis never mentions the post-incident review scheduled for 2026-09-16.
The database suggestion is only attributed to Priya Nair and is not endorsed as a cause.
Both time calculations (21 and 50 minutes) are derived from real timestamp pairs in the ticket, even though they use non-standard reference points.
